contexts.text: The darkening thence is signified by the people of the north ().
That which comes from the north () = what is sensuous and natural; for, relatively to what is spiritual and celestial, what is natural is as thick darkness, or as is the north to light and the south.
The north () = falsities.
The sides of the north, in the opposite sense, = perverted doctrinal things.
The north () = thick darkness, or no truth.
The north () = those who are in ignorance.
Towards the north, etc. ()... The north = those who are outside the Church, namely, those who are in darkness as to the Truths of faith; it also = the darkness with man.

Those who are from the north () are those who are outside the Church, and in ignorance concerning the name of Jehovah, who nevertheless call upon His name when they are living in mutual charity, and adore a Deity the Creator of the universe...
The king of the north () = those who are in evils and falsities.
The land of the north () = the ignorance or desolation of truth.
A smoke out of the north () = that there is falsity from Hell.

The door of the inner gate that looketh towards the north () = the place where there are interior falsities. The door of the gate of the house of Jehovah towards the north = the place where there are interior evils.
The king of the north = falsities; or, what is the same, those who are in falsities. AC 3448:3.
Thou shalt break forth... to the north and to the south () = the infinite extension of truth; thus all states of good and truth... The north = truth as yet in obscurity. Illustrated.
From the north and from the sea () = those who are in ignorance of truth.
The north () = those who are in obscurity as to truth.
To run to and fro from the north even to the east () = from those Knowledges which are in obscurity to those which are in light.
The north () = those who are in ignorance of truth, and yet are in a life of good.
The north () = ignorance of truth.

The land of the north () = ignorance of good, because of truth... The parts of Canaan which were distant from Zion and Jerusalem represented what is obscure as to good and truth; all this which is in obscurity is called the land of the north, and also the sides of the earth.
Moreover as all the good which inflows with light from the Lord is terminated in the obscurity of man, the north is also called an assembly. Illustrated.
The north () = those who are more remote from the light of good and truth.
The land of the north () = those who are in ignorance of good and truth, but in a life of good, in which are the upright gentiles...
Out of the land to the north () = from the obscurity of ignorance of good and truth.
These are said to be from the north () because from the Natural where there is relatively obscurity and a terminus.
That the north, and the west, in the opposite sense, = falsity and evil. Illustrated.
(From these passages) it is evident what is signified by the north in the opposite sense; namely, the falsity from which is evil, and the falsity which is from evil...
From the obscurity which is of the natural man there arise both truth and falsity. Explained... Hence it is that with the former the north = truth, and with the latter falsity...

That the north = the thick darkness of falsity... is evident from  ... Concerning the king of the south and the king of the north; where by the king of the south are signified those who are in the Knowledges of truth; and by the king of the north, those who are in falsity ()... The king of the north = those who are at first in shade, and afterwards in the thick darkness of falsity...
Evil out of the north () = from man's Sensuous and the derivative Scientific.
The king of the north = falsities from evil.
A people out of the land of the north () = those who are in falsities from evil.
The north () = the Sensuous and Corporeal of man, from which evil springs.
To bring them out of the land of the north () = out of the obscurity of faith.
This state of truth in shade is signified by the north.
To say to the north () = to those who are in darkness or ignorance concerning the truths of faith, who are the gentiles outside the Church.
The king of the north = reasoning from scientifics concerning truths.
For the other side of the Habitation to the angle of the north () = towards the exteriors of that Heaven where truths are in obscurity... The north = the exteriors where truth is in obscurity.
There are four states to which correspond the four quarters... The north corresponds to a state of truth in shade... The state of truth to which the north corresponds is an exterior one...
In Heaven... to the north are those who are in the shade of truth.

Thou shalt put the table at the side of the north () = good in obscurity... The north = what is obscure as to the truths of faith; and, when truth is in obscurity, good also is in obscurity with it. For, in the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, good appears through truth... Hence it may be evident why that table was placed at the side towards the north.
And so at the corner of the north in length () = where the good of truth is in obscurity. The corner of the north = where truth is in obscurity...
The north () = the state of the truth of faith in the external man.
The north () = those in the Church who are in an obscure state as to truth.
The north () = an obscure state as to the truth of faith; and also thick darkness from falsities.

Breadth is reckoned from the south to the north; and by the south and the north is signified truth from one terminus to the other. Such is the case in Heaven... Those who are in the obscure light of truth are in the north.
For the sides, which are called ribs, look to the south and the north... and by the north is signified truth in shade.
In Heaven... on the left hand are those who are in the shade of truth, thus those who are in the north.
Those are said to be at the north () who are in falsities.
In Heaven... at the right is the south, and at the left is the north; and this in every turning of the face and body. HH 142.
To the south and north dwell those who are in the derivative wisdom... to the north those who are in the obscure light of wisdom.
In like manner in each Society of Heaven... to the north are those who are in less light of wisdom and intelligence.
Hence... the north = wisdom and intelligence in obscure light.
The north (to those in Hell) is on the left.
Those (infernals) who are in the falsities of evil dwell from their south to their north.

Instructions are given... especially by those Angels who are in the northern and southern quarters; for those angelic Societies are in intelligence and wisdom from the Knowledges of good and truth. The places of instruction are to the north...
Evil Spirits whose dwellings are in the middle quarter between the north and the west...

There are many Hells in the northern and southern quarters. In these are those who... had been in the love of the world, and thence in evils of various kinds... The worst Hells of this kind are in the northern quarter... Their direfulness increases in proportion as they are nearer to the western quarter...
That (kingdom of Hell) which is opposite to the Spiritual Kingdom is in the northern and southern quarter; and those who are there are called Spirits.
The Germans (appeared) towards the north.

In the north dwelt those (Babylonians) who had excelled less in cleverness, and had confirmed themselves less in their religiosity, from the fact that they had been in an obscure faculty of seeing, and thence had been in blind faith. There was not so great a multitude there as in the south. Further described.
The Last Judgment upon those in... the northern quarter, where also there was a great city, Described.
In the northern quarter (of London there) dwell those who surpass all the rest in loving the freedom of speech and writing.
After the Last Judgment the Jews were translated into the north... SE 5619:2.
Waters ascending out of the north () = falsities from Hell.
Those who are in a lower degree of wisdom dwell in the north. Hence the north = wisdom in shade.
Those who are less in wisdom see the Lord obliquely to the left; therefore these are in the north.
The king of the north = those who are in falsities. ( = those who are in darkness from evil. AE 31:4.) AE 355:21. AE 514:14.
These (here treated of) pass their time in the northern quarter... AR 456:2.
I heard a sound as of a mill; it was in the northern quarter...
In the northern quarter... I heard as it were a noise of waters...

On the north three gates () = that the Knowledges of truth and good... by which there is introduction into the New Church, are for those (also) who... are less in wisdom or the affection of truth. Explained.
Those who are less in wisdom from the affection of truth... dwell in the north.
(Two companies of Spirits from the north: their sentiments concerning eternal happiness.)
They were introduced to an assembly in the northern quarter...
If polygamists invade, they are cast out into the darkness of the north... The darkness of the north is dullness of mind, and ignorance of Truths.
The people of the Iron Age pass their time in the north on the side of the west...
A man came running vehemently from the northern quarter...

In the higher northern quarter near the east... there are places of instruction for boys, for youths, for men, and also for old men. Into these places are sent all who die as infants, and are being educated in Heaven... This tract is near the east, in order that all may be instructed through influx from the Lord...
They were looking towards the west and the north.
A black cloud coming out of the north...
I saw in the north a paved way, so crowded with Spirits that there was scarcely room to step between two. Explained.
I was brought in spirit into the north. (The frozen scenery of the boreal Spirits described.)
In boyhood, as man learns the first lessons of religion, he gradually (as to his spirit) leaves the north for the south... For in the Spiritual World... in the north dwell those who are in ignorance.
Concerning the north, and concerning those who dwell there. Described... Those who are there are those who have been in natural truth, and have lived a good life in it or according to it.
See Last Judgment. SE 5346:end. SE 5476. SE 5503. SE 5654.

In the northern quarter, towards the west, there are those who are dull... but towards the east there, dwell those who have insinuated and seduced by lies, thus who have been cunning and malicious in that way...
To the north (in the other life) are those who are not in light, thus are in worldly things, and in riches; thus who are relatively in darkness and poverty.
Therefore the most cunning and deceitful are near the north there, where are the most stupid. Such are their Hells.
When Europe is mentioned, the Angels perceive the north.
The north () = falsity from evil.
The north () = falsity; here, the falsity from which is evil.
The north and the south () = where the truth of faith is in obscurity, and in clearness.
The land of the north () = where is the falsity of ignorance.
A people coming from the north () = those who are in falsities from evil.
To the left there, is the north... and by the north is signified Divine truth in shade.

By the west, the north, and the south, towards which the ram pushed () are signified the goods and truths which those receive who are in charity and the derivative faith, and by which they disperse evils and falsities.
The multiplication of truth thence is signified by its spreading itself towards the north and the south ().
By the north () is meant what is obscure of truth with them.
By the north from which he will come () is signified the source whence all falsity comes; in special, the Hell from which it arises.
The land of the north () = whence are falsities... For by the north is signified that which is remote from truths.
The sides of the north () = what is remote from goods and truths; and thus whence come falsities of evil.
The land of the north () = the Hell where there is nothing but falsity.
From the north to the east () = on every side where there are truth and good; the north = where truth is in obscurity.
By the north () is signified the natural and sensuous man, and the Scientific which is there.
The north () = is obscure of truth; thus those who are outside the Church...
The north () = where are those who are in the falsities of evil, because in darkness.

The sides of the north () = truths from celestial good... because those who are in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, in Heaven, dwell in the east; and those who are in truths from this good, towards the north there.
The sides of the north () = the truths in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom.

By Cry ye to the north () is signified to those who are in falsities and the derivative evils... because those who are in falsities and the derivative evils, in the Spiritual World, dwell in the northern quarter.

The north () = the exterior or ultimate things of the Church... because, in the Spiritual World... in the northern quarter are those who are in what is obscure of truth from the Lord; and beneath them in the Hells there, those who are in falsities, but not in any natural lumen by which they have confirmed their falsities.
In the northern quarter dwell those who are in the obscure light of truth.
Into the two quarters northern and southern, the Lord inflows with Divine truth more strongly than with Divine good; whence these are more in wisdom and intelligence.
With those who dwell below the Heavens upon the earths... the determinations of the winds are from the quarters into which the Divine inflows, especially from the north.

Those Angels and Spirits who are in truths from the good of love to the Lord dwell in the south and the north... The Divine truth which inflows from the east into the west is in its essence the good of love; whereas that which inflows into the sides both ways is in its essence truth from that good; hence those who dwell in the south and in the north... are in the light of truth; those who are in the south are in the clear light of truth, and those who are in the north are in the obscure light of truth. The light of truth is intelligence and wisdom... Therefore (in the Word) the south = truth from the good of love in clearness; and the north, truth from that good in obscurity.

But... in the southern and northern quarter (under the Lord as a Moon, which is 30 degrees distant from the former one) are those who are in truths from the good of charity towards the neighbour, which are called the truths of faith. These quarters also are sometimes mentioned in the Word...
The land of the north () = a state of ignorance, and (also) the falsity of religion.
The tribe of Asher encamped on the north, because in Heaven those dwell to the north who are in the affection of spiritual Knowledges from the good of charity.
The north from which evil looks forth () = the falsity of evil.
Waters from the north () = the falsities of doctrine which are from Own intelligence. Coro 34:2.
The north () = those with whom there is falsity, and the source of it.
The north () = the Hell where and whence are falsities of doctrine and falsities of faith... Hence a smoke cometh from the north = vastating falsity from the Hells.
The north where they have stumbled and fallen () = the source of these falsities.
The king of the north = those within the Church who are in the falsities of evil. ( = those who are in knowledge from the Word, and yet not in life... AE 717:17.) AE 811:11.
In Heaven... to the left is the north... and in the north are those who are in the obscure light of truth from good.
The north and the right hand thou hast created ()... As these things, or those who are in them, are in the north and in the south... it is said the north and the right hand.
The north upon which Jehovah will stretch out His hand () = the Church which is in falsities.
Those who are in an obscure perception of truth dwell in the northern quarter (of the cities in the Spiritual World), and also walk there. LJPost 12.
The land of the north () = where are those who are in the falsities of evil.
The reason of this signification of the king of the north, is that the north = night, and also a cold light, such as is the light in winter, from which... there is no fructification.
The north () = falsities.

A people coming from the land of the north () = those who are in the falsities of evil; and, abstractedly, the falsities of evil which are in the Church then vastated. ( = those in Own intelligence who falsify the Word. AE 734:16.)
The north () = the truth of doctrine in obscurity, such as is with those who from ignorance of truth are in falsities, and still long for truths. AE 768:6.
The north () = Hell.
The Spiritual Kingdom consists of the Heavens... which are in Divine truth; and these Heavens are in the southern quarter and in the northern quarter.
To the north (of the London there) dwell those who are not lettered, and who are in the highest freedom of speech, which they love.
